single_framework_candidate_gate: A framework candidate must freeze one recipe and evaluate it on iv_only, anchor_only, and joint. Scope-specific losses, loss weights, backend, prior, sampler, calibration layer, factor-name-specific sparse heads, or glued separately sampled decks are not allowed for a framework claim.
